sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Protect the caged prisoners while fighting three bandit champions — Berg, Zane, and Narella — each with their own health pool. 9-minute cage timer.

sections.heading: What to watch
bullets: The cage must survive the whole encounter — zero civilian casualties is the real win condition, not just killing the bosses.
Waves of regular bandits spawn throughout — don't let them reach the cage unchecked.
The arena has usable hazards (bombs, oil kegs, a beehive) — optional, but worth knowing they're there if the squad is undergeared for a clean kill.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 9:00 cage timer — treat it as the hard wall for this encounter.
